{{Quote|Rookie One, come in. Return at once. Imperial walkers have been spotted near the outer perimeter. We're beginning to evacuate, but we need time.|Gamma Base communications officer|<ref name="RA">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]''</ref>}}
This '''[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] officer''' served at [[Gamma Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

==Biography==
Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces, under the command of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], launched [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] to locate Rebels fleeing [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] following the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|destruction]] of [[Anchorhead Base]]. When he detected a probe droid on Hoth, the officer alerted his [[Unidentified Gamma Base commander|commander]], who dispatched [[Rookie One]] to investigate and destroy it. When Rookie One confirmed the presence of probe droids, the Rebels were forced to [[Battle of Hoth (0 BBY)|evacuate]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Navander_Button.png|thumb|left|[[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] and Romas Navander in ''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]
The Gamma Base commander appeared in the [[1993]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]'' by [[Vincent Lee]]. He was voiced by [[Tony Pope]]. The game depicts a battle between Imperial and Rebel forces on Hoth, three years prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] shown in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. When producing the cut-scenes for the game, the production staff used footage from the [[original trilogy]], editing in footage of members of the game's production staff over the faces of the movie characters. The scene involving the Gamma Base communications officer was taken from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' with associate producer [[Wayne Cline]] taking the place of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Romas Navander/Legends|Romas Navander]].<ref name="RA:TOIG">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault: The Official Insider's Guide]]''</ref>
